_comment: Generated ONCE by Python (cryptography 48.0.1, the reference implementation) via apps/server/proto/grants.py encrypt(). Read by BOTH tests/auth/fernet.test.ts and apps/server/tests/test_proto_grants.py. NEITHER SIDE MAY REGENERATE IT: a vector that is rewritten whenever the two disagree is a loopback, not a cross-language check, and the implementations could drift together with both suites green. If a suite fails here, the implementation is wrong. The plaintext is deliberately non-ASCII so a latin-1 or ascii decode on either side fails instead of passing every ASCII token and corrupting real ones only in production.
